items.title: Tom Albert Interview, 1962-05-07
items.q: He played ballets. ... After I started to play ballets, I took his job. He had a little band in the Nile Jays.

ctx.x: Mm-hm. Oh I wanted to ask you, did you ever hear of a guy called Bobo over there from a concert?
Bobo? What did he play? He played ballets. Left hand. Left hand? Yeah. After I started to play ballets, I took his job.
You took his job? Yeah. Oh yeah?
